This page is generated at *build* time by querying the live catalog directly — the
tables below are real output, not hand-copied documentation, so the docs double as a
smoke test: if a release breaks or a measure gets renamed, this page's next render
shows it.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import duckdb
import pandas as pd

pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 200)

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute("INSTALL iceberg; LOAD iceberg; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;")
con.execute(
    "ATTACH 'canceronice' AS coi (TYPE ICEBERG, "
    "ENDPOINT 'https://icegate-canceronice.seandavi.workers.dev', "
    "AUTHORIZATION_TYPE 'none');"
)
```

## Measures

```{python}
#| echo: false
con.sql("""
    SELECT source, measure_id, label, units, method
    FROM coi.measure.definition
    ORDER BY source, measure_id
""").df()
```

## Releases

What each catalog release was built from — source, upstream version, and when it was
retrieved.

```{python}
#| echo: false
con.sql("""
    SELECT source, source_version, version_method, retrieved_at, row_count, url
    FROM coi.provenance.release
    ORDER BY source, source_version
""").df()
```
